resolution: Confirmed the user's Model_46 save was a healthy RJMD v4 blob containing all 28 semantic membership rows and the complete 10-region dictionary; the loss occurred only during cold hydration. Replaced the split geometry-then-optional-metadata load sequence with one native document-load boundary that validates and installs groups, materials, semantic membership, and the semantic dictionary together, returns a receipt proving semantics landed, and refuses the mount instead of silently showing anonymous geometry. Added a native cold-load metadata regression, kept legacy empty metadata compatible, and verified the actual blob decoder, mesh-edit Zig tests, diff checks, and a ReleaseFast editor ship. The existing saved blob needs no repair and should recover its names on the next rebuilt restart.
